name: i-have-adhd
tagline_zh: 给读你回复的ADHD用户：先给下一步，步骤编号，跨轮次重述状态，砍掉跑题，给具体时间，让胜利可见。一句话。
tagline_en: For ADHD readers: lead with next step, number tasks, restate state, kill tangents, give real time estimates, show.
desc_en: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".
why_zh: 同类工具只会简化，它却主动重构输出结构——每轮都重述上下文，让分心者不用回翻聊天记录。
why_en: Unlike simplifiers, it restructures output and restates context every turn, so a distracted reader never scrolls back.
